description: PyPSA-China builds a provincial electricity-and-heat model with joint investment and dispatch optimisation. The PIK implementation extends earlier studies and develops links to the REMIND integrated-assessment model. The provider is PyPSA (repository owner). Coverage: The current network has one node per Chinese province and can simulate a full year hourly. A 340-node version is described as future work, not a released feature. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The README links MIT terms. That software licence does not establish licences for every source dataset. Limitations: The provider marks the PIK implementation under development. Only capacity-expansion studies are explicitly implemented, despite broader functions in the underlying PyPSA library. For simulation it supports constrained capacity-expansion scenarios for China. Related resources: This is a country-specific workflow based on model-pypsa, whose generic record does not explicitly cover this implementation.
